mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, member_id, content) VALUES (#{postId}, #{memberId}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT c.comment_id, c.post_id, c.member_id, m.profile_id, c.content, c.created_at, DATE_FORMAT(c.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS created_at_str, m.nickname FROM comment c LEFT JOIN member m USING (member_id) WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY c.comment_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET deleted_at = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{comemntId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
